title: ACS/WFC dither reduction with hidden visit validation
summary: Reduce benchmark-authored ACS/WFC count-rate exposures: DQ masking, subpixel alignment, drizzle-like coaddition, aperture photometry, and astrometric QC.
software: standard library only at solve time
taskPrompt: Read input/TASK_PROMPT.md. Implement output/reduce_visit.py and run it on the visible visit. The evaluator adds a hidden visit with different source and dither parameters.
agentMustDo: align all exposures using association shifts and write the intermediate 72x72 mosaic
perform anchor-centered aperture photometry and WCS conversion
write all five exact per-visit artifacts and a QC report

inputFiles.name: TASK_PROMPT.md
inputFiles.description: Scientific workflow and exact output contract.

inputFiles.name: visit_bluefield
inputFiles.description: Visible synthetic F606W visit with three dithered exposures, DQ masks, association and Gaia-like anchors.

inputFiles.name: runtime_env.toml
inputFiles.description: Solve-time runtime declaration; standard library only.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_input
referenceFiles.description: Evaluator-only F814W visit with five sources and four different dithers.

referenceFiles.name: reference_outputs
referenceFiles.description: Oracle artifacts used only by evaluate().

evaluation: Malformed, missing, nonfinite, wrong-schema, or missing-visit output returns 0. The normalized rubric is image/schema 0.35, source completeness and flux 0.30, astrometry/alignment 0.20, QC invariants 0.10, and required report methods 0.05. A score of 0.80 passes; the hidden visit prevents copying the visible answer.
